items.name: tokens
items.title: dfdl tokens
items.description: The dfdl design tokens: OKLCH primitives and semantics, light and dark, two approved accents, quiet mode. tokens.css for Tailwind v4 projects; tokens.hsl.css (HSL channel triples) for Tailwind v3. Generated from decisions in dylanfernandezdelara/dfdl-ui.
items.author: Dylan Fernandez de Lara
items.docs: Import styles/dfdl/tokens.css from your global CSS. Tailwind v3: point theme colors at hsl(var(--hsl-bg-page) / <alpha-value>) from tokens.hsl.css. Tailwind v4: install https://dfdl-ui.fernandezdelaradylan.workers.dev/r/theme.json instead.

items.name: theme
items.title: dfdl theme
items.description: Tokens, the Tailwind v4 mapping and motion utilities, and cn configured with the dfdl vocabulary. Install this before any component.
items.author: Dylan Fernandez de Lara
items.docs: New app: replace the contents of your global CSS with @import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; @import "../styles/dfdl/tokens.css"; @import "../styles/dfdl/theme.css"; @import "../styles/dfdl/base.css"; (shadcn init's own theme block would override the theme). Existing app: import tokens.css and theme.css after tailwindcss and before your own @theme, and skip base.css to keep your page defaults. Load Lora with next/font as --font-lora. Set the accent on <html data-accent="ember"> or "indigo".
